prompt:
Create one landscape 3:2 Minecraft architectural MOOD BOARD on a plain warm light background. Title: "PIKE PLACE / NORTH END". Public catalog concept for vanilla Minecraft Java 1.21.1, scale 1.4 blocks per metre. Crisp authentic voxel blocks, block-built details, no smooth architectural surfaces, no characters or animals.

Layout: top two thirds contain THREE small complete-building thumbnail takes, each showing BOTH the long Soames-Dunn Building (1918), including the original Starbucks, and the taller Butterworth Building (1903). Each thumbnail is a complete recognisable site study; vary parapet stepping, awning rhythm and block massing subtly, while preserving actual orientation and footprint character. Labels: "01 STREET RHYTHM", "02 STEPPED ROOFS", "03 BLUFF + REAR". Show one view from west/low x toward the Soames-Dunn streetfront, one from east/high x toward Butterworth's main facade, and one elevated view showing both elongated irregular building masses and their stepped foundations. Add a tiny orientation key: "WEST / BAY / low x", "EAST / 1ST AVE / high x", "NORTH / low z". Pike Place runs along z west of Soames-Dunn; 1st Avenue is uphill east of Butterworth. Never rotate either building within the site. The long axis is z, northwest end low z, Pike Street high z.

Soames-Dunn: elongated TWO-storey red brick and warm cream stucco commercial row, west/low-x face on Pike Place. Repeated paired upper windows; large wooden-framed display windows under a continuous long dark awning. Original Starbucks is a distinctive brown wooden storefront with wooden door and old BROWN round logo sign, never a green modern logo. Represent the round sign as a stepped pixel disc made from vanilla blocks, with a pale pixel emblem. "STARBUCKS" lettering, and adjacent "BAVARIAN MEATS" storefront lettering. Flower boxes. Low flat roofs, parapets, stepped connected wings, irregular rear recesses and southern courtyard notches rather than a solid rectangular slab. Bounding plot 60 x 159 blocks, reference roof about y47, maximum y69; absolute placement x400..459,z89..247.

Butterworth: elongated FOUR-storey red brick historic commercial building, main ornamental shopfront facade faces EAST/high x on 1st Avenue; west/low x back faces Pike Place. Upper windows have block-built arched brick heads, pale stone sills and strong repetitive vertical bays; substantial projecting layered cornice, flat dark roof behind parapet. Show its rear as more utilitarian. Bounding plot 54 x158 blocks, roof about y44, maximum y65; absolute placement x461..514,z88..245. Ground rises from low x to high x about 1 to11 blocks; all walls and stepped foundations meet the sloping ground, extra lower storeys exposed downhill, never floating or buried. Keep construction within irregular footprint silhouettes: long narrow masses, small stepped perimeter setbacks; Soames-Dunn has deeper rear courtyard cutouts in its southern half, Butterworth is mostly a long slab with modest end setbacks. These are concept thumbnails, not executable footprint diagrams.

Bottom area: FOUR close-up voxel detail callouts with fine leader lines and readable captions: "BROWN LOGO + TIMBER DOOR" (Starbucks brown stepped disc, wood door and shop glazing); "AWNING + FLOWER BOX" (continuous dark eave, paired upper windows and planter); "ARCHED BRICK WINDOW" (Butterworth stepped arch and pale sill); "HEAVY CORNICE" (Butterworth layered projecting brick/stone eave). Warm dusk light glows through windows and near-window shop displays; vanilla lanterns beneath awnings, restrained warm emissive blocks. Light background stays plain and bright, dusk lighting belongs to the building miniatures.

Across the bottom edge a well-spaced block palette strip grouped by role. Each swatch is a clearly visible Minecraft cube or pane, with its EXACT ID lettered legibly beneath it; use these 12 IDs verbatim, no substitutions:
WALLS: minecraft:bricks, minecraft:terracotta, minecraft:smooth_sandstone
TRIM: minecraft:cut_sandstone, minecraft:brick_stairs
ROOF: minecraft:gray_concrete, minecraft:stone_brick_slab
WINDOWS: minecraft:glass_pane, minecraft:brown_stained_glass_pane
ACCENTS: minecraft:dark_oak_planks, minecraft:spruce_trapdoor, minecraft:lantern
Use matching palette materials throughout, plus vanilla spruce doors, flower pots and plants, brown/white blocks for pixel signage, and warm lights as needed. Only vanilla blocks existing in 1.21.1: no pale oak, no resin, no later-version blocks, no custom models or texture packs. Clean editorial spacing, small restrained headings, highly readable labels, no visual clutter.
reads: Soames-Dunn’s long, two-storey brick and cream commercial frontage.
Original Starbucks storefront in dark timber, with a brown round pixel logo and wooden door.
Continuous dark awning above large, warmly lit shop windows.
Paired upper windows with colorful flower boxes.
Butterworth’s taller red-brick mass with repeated arched windows and pale sills.
Flat parapet roofs, stepped wings and rear recesses.
Sloping ground with stepped masonry foundations and downhill exposure.
Warm window light and hanging lanterns for the dusk atmosphere.
